title: Meguiar's Gold Class Car Wash 1.4 Litre $17.99 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Supercheap Auto
body:
Deal: Meguiar's Gold Class Car Wash 1.4 Litre $17.99 + Delivery ($0 C&C) @ Supercheap Auto

[Gomo] Pro-Tip works amazing in a snow foam cannon
[whyisave] That Bowden snow-foam cannon (at $99+) is quite expensive.
I got cheaper foam cannon from AliEx, for under $25, and that's been good.
[Covid19] Ah nice, can you please link the one you've been using and been happy with?
[whyisave] Brand was called "Bearforce".
So, look for that name.
Mine was something like this:
- https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005012830561144.html
The important thing to ensure you get the right connector and it's better if that connector is made of brass / metal (I avoid the plastic connectors, which could be cheaper….because it's plastic).
[perhaps] been running the bowdens cannon for 7+ years. Yes its exxy but it'll last a bloody long time :)
[whyisave] This is most probably true, because my first $20+ foam-cannon (from AliEx) died after about 3 years.
I'm now about 1.5 years into another foam-cannon ("Bearforce" from AliEx), so let's see… 😁
[pandas] MJJC - google it plenty of reviews.
https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005004457909542.html?spm=a2…
True ozbargainer will stack with current AliExpress coupons, Topcashback (currently at 26%, was 35% yesterday), and use coin discounts through app for existing app users :)
[wisb0] I have used a few car washes such as sca homebrand, turtlewax, armourall and have found all of them to be not bad. I liked the homebrand the best. Is meguiar's gold class really any better than the ones that are $5/litre?
[Gomo] much more suds, check YouTube Clips like This one
[troyww] I've tried plenty of others and for ease of use and how long it keeps shining it is a winner .
I give my car a proper polish twice a year and this monthly as it is not garaged .
[browser] Great price, possibly ATL .
Would buy if not already have 2 bottles.
[Gomo] I purchased 2 even though I have a 1.89L unopened, The shelf life is endless I'm sure!
[htc] not atl, the bunning, amazon price match, $20.99 for 1.89 l is cheaper, this one is only 1.4 litres. Still one of the lowest. Don't have any bottles but got car wash from other brands, already thinking these will last a while.
[whyisave] ATL
All the other deals, are for 1.89 litres.
This deal is for the 1.4 litre bottle.
EDIT:
Sorry.
The reply above me, already mentions this.
[BucketOfPie] Thanks OP had a $20 voucher expiring this week and bought 2, stocked up!
[AaronL] My Meguiars Ultimate Wash & Wax has just come to an end. Is this a good replacement?
[Gomo] I use it alot, along with Bowdens Own Wash & Wax
[TheCad] In other news.. is Meguiars NXT gen wash discontinued?
[ATangk] Why is this smaller than the previous size? I'm concerned…
[browser] Good catch, I thought 1.4L sounds a bit odd.
Just checked, the original and updated bottle are both 1.89L.
[Carbro] Anyone care to share their preferred dilution ratio using a foam cannon?
[dblade123] I use the Bowden's own snow blow cannon with a 9:1 ratio like it says on the bottle. It foams really well
[ATangk] I usually do 1:10 (100ml top up with WARM water). The warm water part makes the biggest difference IMO.
[DR-JEKL] Meguiars hyperwash on sale is a much better product IMO, it has an insane 400:1 dilution ratio whereas the gold class is 5:1 ratio
https://www.supercheapauto.com.au/p/meguiars-meguiars-hyper-…
